temperature: Each model default, as specified by the unchanged benchmark
thinking: Not explicitly set, as specified by the unchanged benchmark
method: Original benchmark prompts, generation calls and scoring. A wrapper records final response text, prompts, timings and model metadata without changing requests or scores. Models run sequentially.
metric: Exact preservation of the notes with one requested line changed; one corrective retry allowed. Formatting differences can fail. This is not a semantic summarisation benchmark.
hardware_scope: Models selected for a 16 GB consumer machine with modest context. The timing measurements are from this 128 GB M5 Max, not a representative standard laptop.

interruption.recovery: Completed prompts, final responses and token counts are retained in qwen3_8b.responses.jsonl. Replay these through the unchanged scorer, then continue with missing calls.

cache_validation: All 168 recorded Qwen requests match the original benchmark prompts and retry messages.

final_verification.result: All cached prompts, retry histories, tokens, scores, summaries and chart reproduce exactly with the unchanged benchmark. Model digests are consistent.
